issue.title: add_any_connection not working as intended
issue.body:
Currently trying to get some of the examples to run on my Windows 11 system and haven't been successful.

I'm building the examples with the local install of MAVSDK (from mavsdk-windows-x64-release) rather then building from source, and including the mavsdk.dll in the same directory as the executable for each example. When trying to run each example as intended ex: "./build/Debug/gimbal_device_tester.exe udpin://0.0.0.0:14540" Ill get an error saying that the protocol / connection URL is invalid, and when switching to "udpin://:14540" the error doesn't appear, but when `add_any_connection` is called during execution it hangs indefinitely, and eventually causes the program to abort with no indication of why this is happening.

Same behavior is observed running other examples such as: takeoff_and_land, autopilot_server, etc.

  C:/Users/evan/Documents/MAV/MAVSDK/Build/third_party/openssl
  failed to build!
Call Stack (most recent call first):
  third_party/CMakeLists.txt:40 (build_target)```

Hoping to figure this out, and attempting to run the examples.

As mentioned it seems the incompatibility between doing a debug build of the examples with the release binaries was the reason for this issue. Considering:

After running: ```cmake --build build --config Release -j4``` over ```cmake --build build -j4``` I was able to get the examples up and running using the release binaries.

A similar situation is documented in: https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/issues/1902 and as @julianoes mentioned I think it would be worthwhile to include this detail regarding appropriately setting build config. 

Thank you both for your time given to the matter.

@guo543 please create a new separate issue and provide the steps for me to reproduce, thanks.
